ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Angie One uses the camera to analyze your meals, read barcodes and labels, and take your progress photos (they stay on your phone).
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Angie One uses the photos you choose to analyze meals or labels and for your progress photos (they stay on your phone).
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Angie One uses the microphone only if you dictate a meal by voice.
